facts.label: Hábitos com frequência
facts.sub: Use always, usually, often, sometimes e never antes do verbo: I always bring a lunch box. She often eats fruit. I never bring cookies.

facts.label: Frequência
facts.sub: Os advérbios de frequência mostram a regularidade: always, usually, often, sometimes, never. Eles vêm antes do verbo: I always bring a lunch box. I sometimes buy lunch.

facts.label: Verbo com s
facts.sub: Com he, she e it, o verbo leva -s: She often eats fruit. My mom usually packs fruit. Com I, you, we e they, o verbo fica na forma base.

pages.title: A school cafeteria · 1/3
paragraphs: It is lunchtime in a busy school in Denver. The cafeteria is loud and full. Nina opens her blue lunch box. Her classmate Otto sits next to her. He looks at her food. He asks about her lunch.
“Nina, what do you usually eat for lunch at school?” says Otto. “I always bring a lunch box. I usually pack a sandwich.” says Nina. “Do you ever buy lunch at the cafeteria?” says Otto.

pages.title: Encontre a frase natural

opts: I always bring a lunch box.
I always am bring a lunch box.
I bring always a lunch box.
items.why: The adverb goes before the verb.

opts: I am usually pack a sandwich.
I usually am pack a sandwich.
items.why: Do not use am with a main verb.
